acknowledged.thm:generic-cover-separation: Delivered headline result: the paper's genericity claim (the ancestral-cover separation set is open and dense in every nonempty DAG/sign stratum, with meagre closed nowhere-dense complement). It is a terminal conclusion of the paper, not an input to a later statement, so nothing consumes it by construction.
acknowledged.thm:simultaneous-confidence-edges: Delivered headline result: the finite-sample inference half of the contribution — simultaneous validity and, under the stated separation margin, exact recovery of the confidence edge set. Terminal by design; the decoding theorem is its population counterpart, not its consumer.
acknowledged.def:sample-split-confidence-graph: Consumed by thm:simultaneous-confidence-edges, whose statement is about this estimator: it is the algorithm the inference theorem certifies, and the paper cannot state that theorem without it. It reads as unconsumed only because the consuming theorem is itself terminal.
